title: Schedule of Charges: Salon, In-Room Services and Dry Cleaning (Ancillary and Optional Services Billing)
content:
Prices of the center's salon, in-room and dry-cleaning services under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing. The same price applies in every ancillary account tier (Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing, Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B, Ancillary Account, Medical Assistance, Ancillary Account, Private Pay, Ancillary Account, Medicare Advantage and Ancillary Account, Hospice Election).

## Beauty shop and barber

| Service | Price |
|---|---|
| Beauty shop wash and set | USD 28.00 |
| Haircut | USD 22.00 |
| Permanent wave | USD 68.00 |
| Hair color | USD 54.00 |
| Barber shave | USD 12.00 |
| Manicure | USD 15.00 |

## In-room services, per month

| Service | Price |
|---|---|
| In-room cable television | USD 42.00 per month |
| In-room telephone line | USD 29.00 per month |

## Dry cleaning

| Service | Price |
|---|---|
| Dry cleaning of a personal garment | USD 7.50 per item |

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical selections)

- Dry cleaning is priced per personal garment: three garments at USD 7.50 per item come to USD 22.50.
- A wash and set (USD 28.00) and a hair color (USD 54.00) are two separately priced services; neither price changes with the tier of the account.
